trivial-edit.describe: a trivial one-file change: a typo, a copy edit, a constant tweak, or a quick factual question with no design judgement

scoped-implementation.describe: well-scoped implementation that follows an existing pattern already in the codebase: a new level from an existing template, tuning constants, routine asset wiring, docs

architecture-or-unknown-bug.describe: debugging a fault with no known cause, architecture or multi-system integration work, or anything where the root cause is hidden and the fix is not obvious

episode2-3d.describe: Episode 2 work: the 3D minecart runner, protocol chambers, the runner-to-chamber loop, GLB assets, or the Gold Mine economy

security-or-deploy.describe: touching secrets, wallet or crypto UI, dynamic execution, file IO, CI configuration, or the deploy and export pipeline

art-or-audio.describe: generating or wiring sprites, backgrounds, sound effects or voiceover assets

unknown.describe: does not clearly fit any other class, or the request is ambiguous
